ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels with a very low white-to-black ratio, approximately 1:20. High-intensity pixels are localized to scarring and peripheral biological growth.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-grey-to-black field. Discrete high-contrast white linear feature on the left lobe (approx. mid-span). Sparse, small white circular clusters (focal spots) on the lower right lobe. High-intensity jagged clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, shallow U-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 115-125 degrees; minimal vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Generally smooth trailing edge with low-amplitude variations. High-frequency pixel-level jaggedness increases significantly toward the distal tips due to macro-biological attachments.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex posterior boundary sweeping upwards and outwards to tapered, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, raised circular and cylindrical pixel clusters (consistent with Coronula diadema) localized heavily on the distal tips and outer trailing edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white, unaligned linear scratches on the left lobe, including one prominent horizontal mark and several smaller diagonal streaks. Faint vertical rake marks present on the upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive macro-parasitic colonization (barnacles) on both distal tips; multiple healed white rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Type 5 pigmentation classification (nearly entirely black) with unique white scar pattern on the left-central lobe surface.
